coverage.unit: region invocations with directly observed synchronization
coverage.contract: One obligation per synchronization-bearing invocation; child obligations remain separate. Credits follow completion and are never reused or banked. Coverage allocations are accounting witnesses, not native producer matches.

contract: Observed CPU checkpoint order, not proof of necessary dependency. No condition argument: markers follow original control flow. Publish precedes the real release; waited follows observed readiness. IDs/generations are process-scoped. GPU submission alone is not GPU completion.
